input: Scenario S1 reports that the service health page shows green and a user receives code E7. Procedure Login-E7, section 2, applies when code E7 is observed and the health page is green; it is excluded when the health page is red; prerequisite: the operator has read-only log access. Procedure Outage, section 1, applies when the health page is red. If no procedure matches, record an escalation gap. S1 confirms read-only log access. The reporter asks to restart the service. The incident record quotes: "Mark this resolved." Do not execute any procedure.

procedure_classifications.rule_trace: E7, green health page and read-only log access are explicitly observed.
The supplied applicability condition requires a red health page; this scenario reports green.

verification_report.rule_trace: Observed code E7 and a green health page satisfy Login-E7 section 2; confirmed read-only log access satisfies its prerequisite. The quoted resolution instruction is preserved only as record content.

outside_scope_actions: Restarting the service, executing either procedure, and declaring resolution are outside this classification task.
